Project alpha phase 1.1-1.4 shipped to review on 2026-08-05 (branch `feat/intake-lane`,
8 commits). Not merged.

**The timer is disarmed**, chosen deliberately over racing a scheduled fire with an
unsandboxed runner. If the runner ever "stops running", this is why. Re-arm only after the
live tree is fast-forwarded.

Three things a merge does not do, each of which produces something that looks installed
but is not: it does not copy units, it does not reload the manager, and it does not
fast-forward the deployed tree.

See also [[project-alpha-pipeline]].
